purpose: Official vendor icons used only to identify supported sources in agent-bom architecture and workflow documentation.

assets.terms: AWS permits customers and partners to use the architecture icon assets in diagrams and related materials. AWS marks remain AWS property.
Microsoft permits these icons in architecture diagrams, training materials, and documentation. Do not crop, rotate, distort, or use them as the agent-bom product mark.
Google provides the official icon library for diagrams and technical documentation. Google Cloud marks remain Google property.

neutral_icon_policy: Use agent-bom neutral category icons when a vendor does not publish redistributable diagram assets or when trademark terms are unclear.
